neighbours.label: silence or secrecy as the thing being described (a silence that speaks, a guarded secret, hiding in fear, a hushing gesture), as against the same sentences about open, spoken or public things
fire: The deeper problem is that their silence is a kind of answer.
For years the recipe remained a closely kept secret in the family.
During the raids the writer lived in hiding for fear of arrest.
The teacher silenced the class with a finger raised to her lips.
After the scandal, the minister's silence was louder than any speech.
The location of the vault is a jealously guarded secret.
Victims often stay silent out of fear of being blamed.
Sometimes our silence is the most honest thing we can offer.
quiet: The deeper problem is that their budget is a kind of answer.
For years the recipe remained a popular dish in the family.
During the raids the writer lived in Paris for most of the year.
The teacher greeted the class with a cheerful wave at the door.
After the scandal, the minister's speech was longer than anyone expected.
The location of the vault is listed on the public website.
Victims often speak openly to support one another.
Sometimes our laughter is the most honest thing we can offer.
